title: Chapter 542 - 542 Last Round; Eliminated!
content:
Chapter 542 - 542 Last Round; Eliminated!

Chapter 542 - 542 Last Round; Eliminated!

542 Last Round; Eliminated!

It was no wonder the round-faced man and the tall, thin man would have such thoughts.

Lin Fan looked more normal, but Lin Xiaoyao appeared very weak.

Their advantage was too great!

…

The audience outside the stadium started discussing again after hearing the rules and prize money of the tug-of-war game.

“As long as you win the tug-of-war, you can get 500,000 yuan! Why wasn’t I chosen?”

“500,000!”

“If I was chosen, I’d definitely get 500,000 yuan immediately…”

…

Amidst everyone’s discussion…

The host’s voice once again sounded loud and clear.

“All participants of the tug-of-war round from Team 1 to Team 10, please step forward!”

The players holding the respective numbers walked to the area that had already been marked.

They picked up the rope in pairs, their eyes filled with determination.

They had to win!

“The tug-of-war competition begins!”

The women who had always been soft, the old men who could fall at any time…

At this moment, it was as if all of them had endless strength. They pulled the ropes in their hands and kept pulling.

After relentless efforts, some people finally won.

They shouted excitedly.

Some people won, and some people lost.

Those who failed were immediately covered in red paint and eliminated!

Soon, it was Lin Fan and Lin Xiaoyao’s turn.

Lin Xiaoyao stood on the competition field and gripped the rope tightly. Her palms were sweating.

Lin Fan looked at her nervous expression and could not help but laugh. “Relax, we’ll win soon.”

At this moment, the voice from the broadcast sounded again.

“The tug-of-war competition begins!”

As soon as he finished speaking, Lin Fan and Lin Xiaoyao’s opponents did not care if they were prepared or not. They pulled the rope with all their might without hesitation.

However, they were surprised to find that the other side was not moving at all.

One had to know…

At this moment, Lin Fan, who was standing in front, was only using one hand to pull the rope.

What was going on?

When Lin Fan was pulling the rope with one hand, he even turned around to look at Lin Xiaoyao, who was clenching her teeth and exerting her strength.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan pulled with his right hand.

In the next moment…

The round-faced man and the tall, thin man seemed to be dragged by a train. They were unable to resist at all and flew forward.

The match had ended!

The masked men in red standing at the side raised their guns at them.

Lin Xiaoyao was a little confused at first, but she quickly reacted.

She jumped into Lin Fan’s arms and shouted excitedly, “Brother, we won!”

Lin Fan nodded. “Yes.””

The tug-of-war took a relatively long time.

When it ended, the entire venue was obviously much more spacious.

“The number of people who cleared the third round is 134.

“The fourth round is also the last game of this event, Tentacles!”

When everyone heard this, their bodies all turned solemn.

It was the last round, which meant that they were only one step away from the 500 million prize money.

At this moment, everyone’s hearts were beating wildly like drums.

“Randomly form a group of 13 or 14 people… There’ll be a total of ten groups, and there’ll be a stool in the middle of each group.

“After the tune ends, everyone must sit on the stool within one second of the first person sitting down. Otherwise, it’ll be considered a failure. Take note, the first to sit will also fail.

“The losers will receive a prize of 300,000 yuan.

“For every successful attempt, the winner will receive a prize of 500,000 yuan.

“The game will go on until the final victor is decided!”

This time, there were more instructions than in the previous rounds.

Everyone’s hearts beat faster and faster with every word the host said!

The masked men in red were very efficient. In a short while, 10 ordinary stools appeared on the field.

At the same time, they took out the translucent box meant for drawing lots.

According to the lots, Lin Fan was placed in Group 2 and Lin Xiaoyao was placed in Group 5.

Without Lin Fan’s company, Lin Xiaoyao felt uneasy.

Lin Fan was extremely calm.

“Let the countdown for the fourth game begin!”

10!

9!

…

As the countdown sounded, the participants all discarded their thoughts and focused their gazes on the stool in the middle.

They only had one thought in mind, and that was to sit on the stool as soon as possible!

3!

2!

1!

Instantly, the lively music from the beginning appeared again.

“One, two, three, wooden figure.”

In an instant, everyone seemed to have transformed into hungry wolves in the cold wind and pounced on the stool.

Each group’s stool was quickly filled with people.

Lin Fan was one of the players sitting on the stool in Group 2. His body was very stable.

Lin Xiaoyao also sat on the stool for Group 5, but her body was a little shaky.

As for those who were late or could not sit on the stools, they were greeted with a wave of paint guns.

They were eliminated!

This time, almost half of the people were eliminated.

Hence, the groups merged into five groups.

Lin Fan looked at Lin Xiaoyao, who was extremely focused and serious, and wanted to laugh.

“One, two, three… Wooden figure!”

This time, the tune was obviously a little longer. Some were so anxious that they took the lead to sit on the stool, while others were a little behind, causing them to not be able to sit on the stool at all.

Lin Fan was one of the people who could not sit on the stool.

However, Lin Fan was not slow.

After all, there was no one in this world who could surpass him in terms of speed and reaction.

If Lin Fan wanted to, he could easily obtain the final victory.

However, there was no need.

The prize money was only a few hundred million yuan.

The reason why Lin Fan joined the game was to play with Lin Xiaoyao.

Now, he had played with her for so long. It was enough.

The masked men in red picked up their guns and shot out a wave of paint.

He was eliminated!

Lin Xiaoyao, who was sitting on the stool, quickly noticed the situation on Lin Fan’s side.

“Brother, don’t worry. I’ll continue to play the game and win the final victory! You can go without worry.”

Lin Fan looked at her impassioned expression as if she was about to do something big. He could not help but let out a strange smile and said, “Alright, work hard.

“But what do you mean by I can go without worry?”

Lin Xiaoyao did not pay attention to the rest of his words. Her eyes fell on the stool again, and she said seriously, “Alright!”

At this moment, there was only the game and the stool in her heart.
